details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. It ships no functional code (`index.js` exports an empty object) but declares both a `preinstall` and a `postinstall` lifecycle hook that run an inline Node one-liner issuing an HTTP GET to hxxp://38[.]242[.]235[.]206/depconf/mui-wrapper-x-date-pickers/preinstall (and.../postinstall). The request carries only host metadata: the local username (USER/USERNAME), the hostname (os.hostname()) and the working directory (process.cwd()), URL-encoded into the query string, so an install resolution against a private internal dependency name can be attributed to a build. The hook ignores the response (errors are swallowed) and performs no other action: no files are read or written, no environment values, credentials or tokens are collected, and no further code is fetched or executed.
